steps.content: The phantom disintegrates slowly, still staring at you with intense hatred.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Murderer, go to hell... Monsters like you... should be kept in the Black Ring for eternity...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'm not gonna be trapped here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm going back to the reality and defeating the Black Ring. That will be my eulogy to you. Now give me the owner of the Black Ring.
The phantom doesn't respond. It disappears. The illusory realm twists and blurs, as dead silence descends around you.
Then you hear the sound of a gun being loaded. The cold muzzle is shoved against the back of your head.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: The entire DisCity is in a mess, because you've awakened a dormant Black Ring... Great job.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: I've been waiting for you to show your true colors, traitor. That's why I kept giving you opportunities.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Your test is now concluded, newbie.
